title: MSFS 2020 Marketplace Update: New Summer Airline Schedules, Jetliner Missions & Skill Challenges
description:
In this video, we’re breaking down the latest marketplace releases so you can skip the long store page menu guessing and know exactly what you are flying next.

The marketplace just dropped a massive wave of new content for Flight Simulator 2020. If you're looking to breathe new life into your simulator sessions, this week features a massive injection of activity updates, real-world airline schedules, and extreme skill challenges. We divide the breakdown into three major categories:

✈️ Structured Missions & Jetliner Overhauls: A deep dive into brand-new IFR flight packages. We cover the 12-Leg Iberia Summer Rotation in the iniBuilds A320 Neo across Spain, France, and Switzerland with custom liveries and authentic audio. Plus, a look at the America 250 United Boeing 787-10 package featuring iconic Stars & Stripes liveries and real-world IFR missions to Newark, Chicago, LA, and Denver (Premium Deluxe required).

📅 The Global Summer Schedule Wave: A look at the massive real-world summer schedules from VA Systems. We cover new airline schedule drops for Hainan Airlines, Fiji Airways, Saudia, Virgin Atlantic, and WestJet, alongside matching airport schedule injections for San Francisco (SFO), Madrid (MAD), Paris, Jeddah (JED), Perth (PER), and Shanghai Pudong (PVG).

🎯 Extreme Landing & Skill Challenges: A close review of the massive Advanced Challenges Vol. 1–3 Bundle. Featuring 72 missions across 40+ aircraft, 5 continents, and 4 climate zones, this bundle delivers dynamic real-weather challenges for everything from light Cessnas to heavy commercial jetliners.

Whether you choose to command a heavy commercial jetliner on authentic summer rotations, populate massive mega-hubs with real-world flight schedules, or test your stick-and-rudder precision in extreme landing challenges, developers are continuing to push incredible variety into the simulator.

Let me know in the comments: are you team long-haul airliner captain or team extreme landing challenger for your weekend flying plans? Drop a comment below, smash the like button, subscribe for weekly simulator updates, and clear skies on your next departure!
